verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's RTX PRO 6000 product page says DLSS 4 is supported on this part, with AI-powered upscaling. However, it frames this around professional real-time photorealistic rendering, and game use only appears as game developers testing games with AI-enhanced graphics tools. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of frame generation on this card, evidence of broad game support or consumer gaming driver compatibility, independent or hands-on gaming corroboration.
